title: State-Space
text: Implement linear state-space system, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Initial conditions} sets Initial state vector; {A}, {B}, {C}, {D}, {Parameter tunability} sets the tunable representation of block parameters, {Allow non-zero values for D matrix initially specified as zero} allows tunability of D matrix when D =, {Absolute tolerance} and {State Name (e.g., ’position’)} sets the option to assign unique names to states. Values come from the instance.
